messages:
maria: quick note — after yesterday's pack allocator tweak (cross-lane interleave) i'm seeing P95/P99 regressions on int8 AWQ weight-only serving.

maria: observed in dedicated staging pool (A100-80GB) under chat-like workload (mostly batch=1 short seqs). baseline p95 ~ 85-92ms, after tweak p95 ~ 130-150ms and p99 up to ~270ms. throughput down ~5-7%.

devon: can you paste the minimal repro and a short perf dump?

maria: repro command:
```bash
./bench_serving --model /models/ggml-awq-7b --quant awq --group-size 64 \
  --pack-mode crosslane --batch 1 --seq 128 --kv-cache true --concurrency 8
```

maria: sample aggregated output:
```
tokens=512 samples=1200 p50=36ms p95=142ms p99=276ms throughput=920 tok/s
kv_cache_hit_rate=80% kv_evictions=3400 pack_overhead_ms=6.5
```

kai: pack_overhead doubled vs baseline (~3ms). also curious about eviction distribution.

maria: eviction histograms:
```
current: 0-16: 480 17-64: 560 65-256: 300 257+: 60
baseline: 0-16: 820 17-64: 210 65-256: 60 257+: 0
```

perf-bot: snapshot: https://internal.perf/shot/2009876543 (flame + kernel routing trace). highlights:
- pack_unaligned_copy cost up
- kernel_router selected ref_int8_matmul for ~11% of calls (vs ~1% baseline)

devon: fallback to ref kernel explains tails. why did routing flip? pack pattern or alignment change?

kai: our fast matmul variants require 64B aligned inputs and certain lane stride; crosslane packing plus slab alignment 32B likely broke that precondition.

olga: quick experiments?
1) legacy pack-mode
2) group-size 32

maria: ran both:
```
legacy + group=64 -> p95 92ms p99 135ms
crosslane + group=64 -> p95 145ms p99 276ms
crosslane + group=32 -> p95 105ms p99 150ms
```

sanjay: group=32 largely removes regression. suggests threshold where optimized kernel is used when group_size <= 32.

devon: propose we add runtime telemetry keyed by (model, group_size, pack_mode) -> kernel_id counts. we only have per-model counters atm.

maria: i'll wire a lightweight counter in kernel_router, push to staging.

perf-bot: note: allocator change moved slab alignment 64B->32B to improve packing density.

kai: short-term mitigations:
- revert allocator (fast)
- config override: force legacy pack for weight-only AWQ models
- runtime: update kernel chooser to be pack-shape aware

sanjay: also consider an aligned-copy fastpath: copy to aligned buffer pre-matmul. measure cost vs fallback.

maria: action items:
- add (group,pack)->kernel telemetry (maria)
- run rollback vs override A/B in perf-ci over 24h (olga + maria)
- prepare revert PR if rollback wins (maria)
- kernel chooser update (kai)
- aligned-copy prototype (sanjay)

olga: tagging @deploy-team in case we need fast rollback :eyes:

maria: customer impact: only staging pools so far; might affect some dedicated customers on same allocator. i'll start an incident if rollback is needed after the A/B run.

devon: I can help bisect commits if needed.

maria: appreciated, will ping. :thumbsup:
